searchText: I came to ask a question which is related to this~ SPHINCS+ 128s costs about 360k gas to verify on an 8141 devnet I ran locally, which is still higher than the 300k cap upgrade mentioned here. How are SPHINCS+ accounts expected to fit in this case, should they go through ERC-8421 alt mempools, where staked entities get a 1M verify budget (BUDGET-010)?

I came to ask a question which is related to this~

SPHINCS+ 128s costs about 360k gas to verify on an 8141 devnet I ran locally, which is still higher than the 300k cap upgrade mentioned here. How are SPHINCS+ accounts expected to fit in this case, should they go through ERC-8421 alt mempools, where staked entities get a 1M verify budget (BUDGET-010)?
